title: black
summary: An ink clue and two French colours.
question: Can word relatives have different meanings?
completion: Black continues Old English blæc. Swedish bläck, meaning ink, is a relative. French noir names the same colour but did not give English black its name.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
